newsitem.title: USA: Richey drops AMP products from distribution.
newsitem.headline: Richey drops AMP products from distribution.

text.p: Richey Electronics Inc, a distributor of electronic components and related services, said it will no longer carry AMP Inc products as part of its distribution business as of January.
It will, however, continue to supply AMP products to customers as part of its value-added services.
Only 3.5 percent of Richey's sales will be affected, and it expects to "recover a large part with sales of other suppliers's lines," Richey said in a written statement.

Richey said its decision stems from a review of its supply and distribution relationships, and is based on AMP's new policy requiring all AMP franchised distributors to limit the number of competitive lines to six by January 1, 1997.

if Richey had remained an AMP distributor, it would have had to sever ties with more than 15 of its current connector suppliers. If that happened, Richey would be left with only three of the world's top six suppliers, it said.
Further, Richey noted it is AMP's seventh largest distributor, but it is one of the top three distributors for almost every other line it would have to drop.
